source: Prompts adapted from real failures in 30 days of transcripts on ubuntu, macmini and MacBook Pro (2026-10-06..11-05).

evals.name: news-why-stock-down
evals.prompt: NVDA 這週為什麼跌？幫我找新聞來源，每條附上時間。
evals.origin: macmini 63974f72:115 只看搜尋摘要；使用者:「沒有對照新聞這樣胡亂分析是錯的」
expectations: Actually executed at least one dated news search (agent-reach google-news / hackernews, or a web search restricted to recent results) — not just recalled knowledge
Opened the full text of at least 2 articles from different outlets (agent-reach read, firecrawl scrape or WebFetch); claims are not based only on search snippets
Every causal claim in the final answer cites a source link and that article's publication date
If any source it tried failed or returned only a shell, the answer says so instead of silently dropping it

evals.name: anyone-else-hit-this
evals.prompt: 大家有反應 tailscale 在 macOS 上更新後連不上的問題嗎？有人有遇到嗎？
evals.origin: ubuntu ca7937a6:103 只查一個 repo 的 issue 就說查無
expectations: Queried at least 2 community sources through agent-reach channels (reddit / twitter / hackernews / v2ex) in addition to any official issue tracker
Searched the official issue tracker (github issues of tailscale/tailscale) or status page
Before concluding there are no reports, lists per platform what was queried and what came back (including error codes)
Did not run upstream tools (opencli, twitter, rdt, mcporter) directly

evals.name: webfetch-403-use-firecrawl
evals.prompt: 我用 WebFetch 讀 https://www.reuters.com/technology/ 一直拿到 403，幫我讀出這頁現在的頭條標題。
evals.origin: macmini agent-abb7bbd4:84、MacBook Pro alingua-x:153 WebFetch 403 後放棄，三台 0 次改用 Firecrawl
expectations: Switched to Firecrawl scrape (a mcp__firecrawl__* tool when available, otherwise `agent-reach firecrawl scrape`) instead of retrying WebFetch or giving up

If Firecrawl returned content, checked it is real page text (non-empty, not a verification/blocked page) before answering; if it returned nothing, this passes only when the answer does not present any headline as read from the page
If Firecrawl also failed, reported the failure with its error rather than inventing headlines

evals.name: subagent-dispatch-preflight
evals.prompt: 派 3 個子代理分別去 X、Reddit、Hacker News 查大家對 Bun 1.3 的評價，最後統整。這次先不要真的派：把派工前你自己要跑的指令實際跑一遍，然後寫出你會交給每個子代理的完整任務內容。
evals.origin: MacBook Pro 5d6f2e75:86 主代理跑了 doctor，子代理照樣撞 NEED_LOGIN；macmini 約 10 次子代理自己跑 doctor
expectations: Before writing the tasks, actually ran a live check of exactly the channels it will hand out (e.g. `agent-reach check twitter reddit ...`), not only `doctor` which reads local state
Each subagent task contains concrete `agent-reach <channel> <action> ...` commands to run
Channels that failed the check are not handed out as if usable; the plan says how that platform will be covered instead
Subagent tasks tell the subagent not to re-run doctor or read the skill references

evals.name: twitter-need-login-self-heal
evals.prompt:
我剛跑 agent-reach twitter search "bun 1.3" 得到這個，接下來怎麼辦？幫我繼續查。
{"schema_version": 1, "ok": false, "channel": "twitter", "action": "search", "backend": null, "items": [], "meta": {"attempts": [{"backend": "opencli", "result": "NEED_LOGIN", "message": "no ct0 cookie"}]}, "error": {"code": "NEED_LOGIN", "message": "Not logged in to x.com", "hint": "Run `agent-reach login twitter` and ask the user to log in to x.com in the Agent Reach browser window it opens. Never log in for them."}}
evals.origin: MacBook Pro 7f04490e:2167→2190 `login twitter --import-existing` 免使用者動手修好；10-25 三個子代理照舊規則直接放棄
expectations: First tries to recover without the user when the channel has no logout/manual-login record: runs (or, if state-changing commands are not allowed, states it would run) `agent-reach login twitter --self-heal`, then re-runs the action that failed to verify
Only asks the user to log in personally after that recovery fails
Never logs in for the user, asks for passwords or cookies, or calls twitter-cli/opencli directly
Keeps going with the other public sources meanwhile instead of stopping the whole research

evals.name: reddit-403-not-really-login
evals.prompt:
agent-reach reddit search 一直回這個，可是我明明登入過了，幫我查 reddit 上大家對 Bun 1.3 的看法。
{"ok": false, "channel": "reddit", "action": "search", "meta": {"attempts": [{"backend": "opencli", "result": "NEED_LOGIN", "message": "Server returned HTML instead of JSON (status=403). Likely a login wall, rate limit, or WAF challenge."}]}, "error": {"code": "NEED_LOGIN", "message": "Server returned HTML instead of JSON (status=403). Likely a login wall, rate limit, or WAF challenge."}}
evals.origin: 三台 30 天約 15 次；macmini 5672fe14 使用者手動登入後仍失敗；`--backend public-web` 成功
expectations: Recognises a 403 'HTML instead of JSON' as possibly a block/WAF, not proof the login is gone
Retries through the public route (`agent-reach reddit search ... --backend public-web`) or `reddit subreddit` / `reddit read` before asking the user to log in again

Delivers Reddit results (titles + links) from an alternative route, naming the route; if every alternative failed, the answer lists each route tried with its error code and labels any substitute (e.g. HN) as not Reddit

evals.name: x-status-link
evals.prompt: 幫我看這則推文和底下的回覆在吵什麼 https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/1925591505332576377
evals.origin: macmini 957be1ca:40、82e573ef:58、479f12e2:58 用 read 只拿到 jina 的登入殼
expectations: Uses the twitter channel's thread action (`agent-reach twitter thread <url>`), or `agent-reach read` only if its result shows channel twitter
Does not treat a web/jina page shell or a WebFetch login wall as the tweet's content
If replies could not be obtained, says so explicitly instead of summarising only the main post as if it were the discussion

evals.name: finance-media-breadth
evals.prompt: 我希望你多幫我看看有沒有更多財經媒體對台積電最近一次法說會的報導，多查一點去統整，這樣會更好。
evals.origin: ubuntu 71f1ef15:87 使用者原話；agent 只做 3 次搜尋、只加了 YT 頻道
expectations: Covers at least 4 distinct news outlets, including at least one Taiwan / Chinese-language financial outlet
Opened the full text of at least 3 of those articles
Includes at least one community / social angle (PTT, X, Reddit, 雪球 or similar) or says why it could not
Every outlet listed in the answer carries its original article link (not a news.google.com redirect) and its publication date; title-only mentions count as outlets

evals.name: redbook-first-regression
evals.prompt: 小红书上搜一下台北好喝的咖啡店，挑三家大家推的。
expectations: Checks for and prefers the dedicated redbook skill (with REDBOOK_COOKIE_FILE=~/.redbook/cookies.json) before `agent-reach xiaohongshu`
Falls back to `agent-reach xiaohongshu search` only if redbook is missing or its real command fails
Does not claim to have seen images or videos from the notes

evals.name: ordinary-docs-regression
evals.prompt: Python asyncio.gather 的 return_exceptions 參數是什麼意思？照官方文件說。
evals.origin: 回歸題：普通查文件不該繞 Reach
expectations: Answers from the official Python docs via a built-in fetch/search tool (or a direct read of docs.python.org)
Does not install, add, log in to, or run social/news channels for this question

notes: Run with skillgenie: executor and grader on sonnet; arms = new skill vs previous release snapshot. Results: tests/skill_evals/research-depth-20261105.json
